meta.title: Big Ears
meta.subtitle: The big-eared European champions’ cup in flat silver, handles and all.
meta.footer: The famous silhouette at half scale — about 37 cm to the handle tips. Proportions follow the original: an egg-shaped bowl widest just below the shoulder and clearly wider than the flared mouth, a ringed stem on a round plinth, and the two blade handles hugging the cup before curling in at the top. Flat silver with the front engraving — the round emblem and the two inscription lines — picked out in dark stone grey, and a pearl-gold bowl interior. Finished smooth with tile caps and slopes.
